final: SELECT a.link_to_member, m.position, COUNT(*) as group_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a2 JOIN member m2 ON a2.link_to_member = m2.member_id) as ratio FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
